title: Delayed Graft Function (DGF) Masterclass & Clinical Management Guide
description: 整合 Delayed Graft Function (DGF) 定義、Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury 機轉、早期少尿之超音波與切片鑑別診斷、及 CNI Delay 誘導抗體與透析支持策略之專科課程。

sections.title: Section 1: Definition, Epidemiology & Ischemia-Reperfusion Pathophysiology of DGF
sections.content:
### 1.DGF 最常定義為 Kidney Transplantation 後首週內（First 7 Days）需要接受 Dialysis。其核心病理機轉為 Ischemia-IRIATIATN。風險因子涵蓋 Donor 類型（Donation after Circulatory Death, DCD 高於 Donation after Brain Death, DBD）、KDPIECD、CITWIT。

| Process Step | Molecular & Cellular Pathway | Clinical Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cold Ischemia | Hypoxia, ATP Depletion, Anaerobic Glycolysis, Na+/K+-ATPase Failure | Epithelial Cell Swelling & Cytoskeletal Disorganization |
| Reperfusion Phase |ROS Generation, Complement Cascade Activation (C3a, C5a) | Microvascular Endothelial Damage & Leukocyte Infiltration |
| Tubular Damage | Detachment of Tubular Epithelial Cells, Loss of Brush Border, Tubular Cast Obstruction | Backleak of Glomerular Filtrate & Abrupt GFR Reduction |
| Clinical Phenotype | Prolonged Oliguria or Anuria in the Immediate Post-Transplant Window | Dialysis Requirement within First 7 Days Post-Transplant |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature |DBD |DCD |ECD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Warm Ischemia Time |Controlled Organs | Prolonged (Agonal Phase & Asystole Window) | Variable |
| DGF Risk | Baseline (20-30%) | High (40-60%) | High (30-50%) |
| Dominant Mechanism | Systemic Cytokine Storm from Brain Death | Severe Warm Ischemia & Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury | Baseline Microvascular & Glomerulosclerosis Vulnerability |
| Primary Mitigation | Donor Hemodynamic Optimization |HMP | Careful Recipient Matching & KDPI Assessment |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Deceased Donor Kidney Transplantation ➔DCD vs DBD & Cold Ischemia Time (>18-24 hours) ➔ Post-Operative Day 1 Oliguria (<0.5 mL/kg/h) ➔ Serum Creatinine Failure to Drop >10% per Day ➔ Requirement of Hemodialysis in Week 1 ➔ Diagnosis:DGFATI ➔ Initiate Hemodynamic Optimization & Avoid Hypovolemia.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 以為 Living Donor Kidney Transplantation 不會發生 Delayed Graft Function。
**Analysis**: 雖然 DGF 主要發生於 Deceased Donor Transplants（特別是 DCD 與 ECD），但若 Living Donor 存在 Surgical Complications、Severe Hypotension、PRA 引發的 Early Rejection，仍可能出現 DGF。不能僅因 Living Donor 而排除 DGF。

sections.title: Section 2: Differential Diagnosis & Systematic Diagnostic Approach to Early Allograft Non-Function
sections.content:
### 1. Systematic Diagnostic Evaluation Matrix

移植後早期少尿或無功能（Immediate Allograft Dysfunction）之診斷需依序排除 Technical/Surgical Complications、Prerenal Azotemia、True DGF 及 Early Rejection。Bedside Ultrasound 配合 Doppler Color Flow 指標（如 Resistive Index, RI）為首選非侵入性檢查工具。

| Category | Specific Diagnosis | Key Diagnostic Finding | Immediate Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Technical / Vascular | Renal Artery Thrombosis | Absent Arterial Doppler Flow | Emergent Surgical Re-exploration |
| Technical / Vascular | Renal Vein Thrombosis | Reversed Diastolic Arterial Flow on Doppler | Emergent Surgical Exploration |
| Technical / Urological | Urinary Leak / Ureteral Obstruction |Uroma or Hydronephrosis |Creatinine Ratio / Nephrostomy |
| Parenchymal / Ischemic | Ischemic Acute Tubular Necrosis | Elevated Resistive Index (RI >0.8), Patent Vessels | Supportive Dialysis & Hemodynamic Optimization |
| Immunological |ABMR / TCMR | High PRA, Positive Donor-DSA | Early Allograft Biopsy & Pulse Steroid / PEX |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature |True DGF | Renal Vein Thrombosis |ABMR/TCMR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing | Post-Op Day 0-1 Immediate | Post-Op Day 1-3 Sudden | Usually Post-Op Day 3-7+ |
| Urine Output | Oliguric / Anuric | Abrupt Anuria with Hematuria | Gradual Decline / Non-oliguric Cr Rise |
| Doppler Ultrasound | High RI, Patent Main Artery & Vein | Reversed Diastolic Flow in Renal Artery | High RI (>0.8), Normal Main Vascular Flow |
| Graft Pain / Swelling | Mild to Moderate | Severe Graft Pain, Enlargement & Tenderness | Variable Graft Tenderness |
| Definitive Diagnosis | Diagnosis of Exclusion / Biopsy | Doppler Ultrasound / Surgical Exploration |Gold Standard |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Immediate Post-Transplant Oliguria / Anuria ➔ Check Foley Catheter Patency & Bedside Ultrasound ➔ Rule Out Hydronephrosis & Perigraft Fluid Collection ➔ Evaluate Renal Doppler ➔ Main Vessels Patent with Normal/RI ➔ Assess Volume Status ➔ If Hypovolemic, Give Fluid Challenge ➔ Persistent Oliguria without Diuresis ➔ Check Donor-DSA & Immunologic Risk ➔Day 3-5Day 7-10 ➔ Perform Renal Allograft Biopsy.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**:RI > 0.8 立即診斷為 Acute Rejection。
**Analysis**: Elevated Resistive Index (RI > 0.8) 代表 Renal Microvascular Resistance 增加，具高敏感度但特異度較低。DGF、Calcineurin Inhibitor Toxicity、Lymphocele/Hematoma 皆會引起 RI 升高。必須結合臨床脈絡與 Allograft Biopsy 作最終裁決。

diagrams.caption: Diagnostic decision flowchart for early renal allograft dysfunction and Doppler Ultrasound evaluation.
Brenner 11e Fig. 70.3: Management flowchart of kidney allograft non-function and oliguria immediately post-transplant.

sections.title: Section 3: Biopsy Indications, Histopathology & Rejection vs CNI Toxicity Reconciliation
sections.content:
### 1. Histopathological Classification Matrix

當 DGF 持續未見改善時，Allograft Biopsy 是區分 Ischemic ATN、Acute T-TCMR、Acute Antibody-ABMRCNI Toxicity 的金標準。高免疫風險患者建議於 Post-Op Day 3-5 進行 Biopsy，低風險患者於 Day 7-10 進行 Biopsy。

| Pathological Entity | Banff Histological Criteria | Key Biomarker / Staining | Distinguishing Feature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ischemic ATN | Flattened Epithelium, Loss of Brush Border, Apoptosis | Negative C4d, Low Tubulitis | Intact Glomeruli & Vessels, Tubular Dilatation |
| Acute TCMR |i-score,t-score | T-cell Infiltration (CD3+, CD4+, CD8+) | Lymphocytes Invading Tubular Basement Membrane |
| Acute ABMR |g-score,ptc | Microvascular C4d Positivity, Positive DSA | Microvascular Endothelial Injury & Donor-Specific Ab |
| CNI Acute Toxicity | Isometric Vacuolization of Proximal Tubules | Negative C4d, Normal Microvasculature | Afferent Arteriolar Vasoconstriction, Reversible |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | Ischemic ATN | Acute ABMR | Acute CNI Toxicity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Peritubular Capillaries | Normal / Congested | Peritubular Capillaritis (ptc > 0) | Normal Microvasculature |
| C4d Immunostaining | Negative | Linear PTC Staining (C4d+) | Negative |
| Tubular Cytoplasm | Flattened, Desquamated | Variable Inflammation | Isometric Microvacuolization |
| Donor-DSA | Negative |HLA Class I or II | Negative |
| Treatment Response | Recovery over Time | Plasmapheresis, IVIG, Rituximab | Dose Reduction / CNI Trough Lowering |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Persistent DGF Beyond Day 5-7 ➔ Perform Percutaneous Ultrasound-Guided Renal Allograft Biopsy ➔ Histology Examination ➔ If Flattened Tubular Cells without Tubulitis or C4d ➔ Pure Ischemic ATN ➔ Continue Supportive Dialysis & CNI Delay ➔ If Tubulitis (t > 1) & Interstitial Inflammation ➔ Diagnosis: Acute TCMR ➔or rATG if severe ➔ If Glomerulitis, Peritubular Capillaritis & C4d+ ➔ Diagnosis: Acute ABMR ➔ Plasmapheresis + IVIG + Rituximab.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 在 DGF 期間發現 Proximal Tubular Epithelial Vacuolization 即判定為 CNI Toxicity 而全面停用 CNI。
**Analysis**: CNI 引起的 Isometric Vacuolization 為精細、非脂質微泡，主要是 Afferent Arteriolar Vasoconstriction 導致。但在 DGF 缺血修復期，Tubular Regeneration 亦可能出現粗大不規則水泡（Hydropic Change）。須結合 CNI Trough Level 與整體 Banff Pathology 判定，避免盲目停藥導致 Acute Rejection 的發生。

Brenner 11e Fig. 70.4: Algorithm for management and biopsy protocol of persistent Delayed Graft Function.

sections.title: Section 4: Evidence-Based Clinical Management, Immunosuppression Optimization & Long-Term Prognosis
sections.content:
### 1. Therapeutic Strategy Matrix

DGF 之臨床處置原則圍繞在「透析支持以防維護併發症」、「血液動力學優化以促進小管復原」、「免疫抑制劑微調（CNI Delay / Minimization）」及「誘導抗體選擇（Induction Therapy）」。

| Intervention Category | Specific Protocol / Target | Pathophysiological Rationale | Clinical Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hemodynamic Support |MAP >80-85 mmHg | Adequate Renal Perfusion Pressure to ATN Tissue | Accelerated Tubular Epithelial Regeneration |
| Dialysis Management | Ultrafiltration to Maintain Euvolemia, Avoid Intradialytic Hypotension | Prevent Secondary Ischemia during Hemodialysis Sessions | Protect Recovering Allograft Microvasculature |
| Induction Therapy | Anti-IL-BasiliximabThymoglobulin | Potent Immunosuppression Allowing CNI Sparing / Delay | Reduce Acute Rejection Risk during DGF Window |
| CNI Delay Strategy | Delay Tacrolimus/Cyclosporine to Post-Op Day 3-7 (or Urine >500 mL) | Avoid Afferent Arteriolar Vasoconstriction during Peak ATN | Faster Recovery of Glomerular Filtration Rate |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Strategy Parameter | Early Full-Dose CNI Initiation | Delayed CNI with Antibody Induction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Immediate Vasoconstriction |Reduces Afferent Arteriolar Blood Flow |Promotes Microvascular Reperfusion |
| Acute Rejection Risk | Low |Protected by rATG or Basiliximab |
| Duration of DGF | Potentially Prolonged | Shorter Time to Diuresis & Recovery |
| Monitoring Requirement | Daily CNI Trough Level Target 8-12 ng/mL | Delayed Trough Target 4-8 ng/mL initially |

### 3.DCD / Long CIT ➔ Select Induction Agent (rATG for High Immunologic Risk, Basiliximab for Low Risk) ➔ Post-Op Day 0:MMF + Corticosteroids ➔ Delay CNI Initiation until Post-Op Day 3-5 or Diuresis Onset ➔Avoid Hypotension ➔ Monitor Daily Urine Output & Creatinine ➔ Diuresis Onset (>1000 mL/day) ➔ Introduce Low-Dose Tacrolimus ➔ Monitor Long-Term Graft Function.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 以為 DGF 只是暫時性小管損傷，不會影響長期 Allograft Survival。
**Analysis**: 雖然多數 DGF 患者的小管功能最終會恢復，但大量臨床數據與 Registry Studies（如 USRDS）顯示，DGF 會increased Subclinical & Acute Rejection 的發生率，CAI 與 Fibrosis 的進展，長期 Allograft Half-Life 較非 DGF 患者縮短。因此，HMP 等方式降低 DGF 發生率。

diagrams.caption: Immunosuppressive antibody induction and delayed CNI initiation protocol in DGF management.
Brenner 11e Fig. 70.5: Algorithm for management of allograft dysfunction and CNI level adjustment.
